capabilities.title: Discover learning opportunities
capabilities.description: Let learners search, filter, compare, and understand available courses, lessons, labs, and projects by topic, level, duration, prerequisites, and availability.

capabilities.title: Navigate a competency-based curriculum
capabilities.description: Show learning objectives, competency relationships, prerequisites, optional branches, completion states, and the requirements for advancing through a curriculum.

capabilities.title: Participate in structured lessons
capabilities.description: Let learners work through versioned educational content, examples, citations, notes, embedded activities, and knowledge checks in a coherent lesson workspace.

capabilities.title: Practice and demonstrate understanding
capabilities.description: Provide diagnostic and formative questions, scenarios, exercises, feedback, targeted review, and repeatable opportunities to produce learning evidence.

capabilities.title: Complete applied projects
capabilities.description: Support guided and open-ended financial, quantitative, AI, and ML projects with milestones, datasets, notebooks, saved results, reflections, and submissions.

capabilities.title: Track progress and competency evidence
capabilities.description: Give learners an explainable view of completions, attempts, feedback, evidence history, strengths, review needs, and competency or mastery projections.

capabilities.title: Follow an adaptive learning pathway
capabilities.description: Recommend eligible next activities based on evidence, goals, prerequisites, and deterministic policy, while explaining why each recommendation was made and allowing learner choice.

capabilities.title: Learn with grounded AI assistance
capabilities.description: Offer learner-controlled tutoring and content interaction grounded in approved educational sources, with citations, limitations, safe fallbacks, and clear separation from authoritative grading or financial advice.

capabilities.title: Explore canonical market data
capabilities.description: Let learners retrieve, inspect, chart, compare, and export provider-neutral market data while seeing timestamps, coverage, quality indicators, attribution, and provenance.

capabilities.title: Perform financial and quantitative analysis
capabilities.description: Provide educational workflows for financial metrics, valuation concepts, comparisons, and reproducible calculations using explicit assumptions and traceable inputs.

capabilities.title: Build and evaluate simulated portfolios
capabilities.description: Let learners create educational portfolios, allocate assets, select benchmarks, rebalance, inspect performance and risk measures, and record decisions without representing custody or live trading.

capabilities.title: Run backtests and scenario analyses
capabilities.description: Let learners test historical strategies, stress scenarios, and portfolio assumptions with reproducible inputs, transparent limitations, and clear separation between simulation and observed results.

capabilities.title: Conduct financial AI and ML experiments
capabilities.description: Support dataset selection, feature work, model experiments, evaluation, leakage and overfitting checks, model cards, reproducibility, and comparison of results in a guided learning context.

capabilities.title: Maintain a personal learning workspace
capabilities.description: Preserve a learner's notes, bookmarks, charts, datasets, simulations, notebooks, projects, and AI conversations so work can be resumed and connected across activities.

capabilities.title: Set learning goals and preferences
capabilities.description: Let learners record goals, experience, interests, accessibility needs, theme choices, AI-assistance preferences, notification choices, and appropriate privacy controls.

capabilities.title: Export and retain portable learning records
capabilities.description: Let learners export their evidence, progress, saved work, and supported data in documented portable formats, with local backup and recovery appropriate to the deployment profile.

capabilities.title: Understand platform methods and limitations
capabilities.description: Provide searchable help, financial and AI/ML glossaries, adaptive-learning explanations, methodology, provenance guidance, AI limitations, and education-versus-advice boundaries.

capabilities.title: Author and maintain learning experiences
capabilities.description: Let authorized creators develop, review, version, and publish curricula, lessons, examples, assessments, projects, competency mappings, and supporting sources through an accepted content format.

capabilities.title: Review learner evidence and provide feedback
capabilities.description: Let instructors inspect permitted evidence and project work, provide feedback, request revision, and make approved overrides with authorization and audit evidence.

capabilities.title: Guide cohorts and learning organizations
capabilities.description: Give authorized instructors or organization leaders privacy-aware views of cohort participation, progress, review needs, and learning outcomes without replacing individual evidence.

capabilities.title: Connect and govern replaceable providers
capabilities.description: Let authorized operators configure market-data, model, content, storage, identity, and job providers through platform-owned contracts, with capability, health, quota, attribution, licensing, and failure visibility.

capabilities.title: Manage identities, organizations, roles, and entitlements
capabilities.description: Support the appropriate local and cloud identity, membership, authorization, organization, and edition-entitlement experiences after the governing identity and tenancy decisions are accepted.

capabilities.title: Preserve provenance and accountable history
capabilities.description: Maintain traceable origins, versions, transformations, and relevant audit history for learning evidence, recommendations, content, market data, datasets, model output, simulations, and administrative actions.

capabilities.title: Operate the community edition locally
capabilities.description: Enable an individual or contributor to install, configure, use, back up, restore, and upgrade the open-source platform locally with supported free-data and externally configured provider connections.

capabilities.title: Operate a managed cloud service
capabilities.description: Enable qualified operators to run the shared platform core as a secure, observable, scalable, recoverable, and supportable managed service without creating different domain behavior.

capabilities.title: Administer platform health and usage
capabilities.description: Provide authorized operational visibility into provider health, jobs, storage, model and data usage, failures, audit events, and edition-appropriate service limits.
